notes.title: The input system has been improved.
notes.notes:
PlayStation 5 is now integrated and tested.
There are now also the corresponding icons for the controller.
All PlayStation controllers (as well as Switch Pro and generic controllers) should now work.

notes.title: Small game balance update.
notes.notes:
Hello pilots!

I've made some adjustments that should improve the gaming experience.

Mainly Mission 28 (the first mission with the jet) was adapted.
The firing interval of most guns has been extended and you now have more time to fly through the tunnels. I also placed a fuel item halfway.

The fuel consumption of all planes has been reduced, which should make the game easier, especially at the beginning when no upgrades have been installed yet.

Some projectiles and missiles now deal less damage.

Have fun!

notes.title: New game balance
notes.notes:
Hello pilots.

I got a lot of feedback that Cavatus is a bit too difficult.
That's why I made extensive adjustments.

The difficulty went down about one level.
It can be said that the old easy is now the new normal.

[h2]What has changed:[/h2]

The enemies are easier to destroy and do less damage themselves.

In addition, the maximum damage you take in a collision has been reduced by 20%.

The damage from landing hard on the runway has also been reduced.
(Only on normal and hard. On Easy there is still no damage)

[h2]What hasn't changed:[/h2]

The amount of fuel, fuel consumption, hitpoints and firepower.
Because these are gameplay things and you should collect the upgrades to improve these values. 

Of course I tested the new balance and I can definitely say that you will feel the changes. :)

Have fun!

notes.title: Fixed two minor bugs.
notes.notes:
There was a little typo bug at the difficulty selection screen.
There was a visual bug (only) on ultra-wide-screens where a info bar was not comletely visible.
Both bugs are eliminated! :)
Have fun!

notes.title: Some adjustments
notes.notes:
Hi there!

I've made the easy-mode a lot easier! 
In the first sectors are less turrets. You will see ruined buildings instead of dangerous turrets.

All Modes:
The first Boss is slower than before in the third phase. The energy beam makes less damage.

I've also made some minor modifications. For example the damage of the enemy bullets or the hitpoints of the rocket launcer.

All vehicle have ~10% more fuel. 
[i](Only if you start a new game. But don't worry. The ammount of fuel is less important in later missions.
So you don't need to restart the game. And much less if you're behind the 1. boss.)[/i]

The biplane can glide a bit a bit longer, because the minimal horizontal speed to gain uplift is lower now.
This will help to hit enemys with your gun.

Have fun!

notes.title: New price!
notes.notes:
Hi pilots!
Many players have now played the Cavatus demo and/or added the game to their wishlist. This is great because it shows that you are interested in the game.
But as it still doesn’t sell, the price is probably too high.

So, I drastically reduced the price of Cavatus.

Well, that's it!

Have fun!

notes.title: Game balance.
notes.notes:
Hi!
I adjusted some values to make the game a bit easier.
The changes apply to all modes but most changes have been made in easy mode.

- Enemy buildings now have fewer hitpoints.
- Enemy projectiles now do less damage.

Have fun!

notes.title: Cavatus demo is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello pilots!
The demo for Cavatus will be activated in a few days. ːsteamhappyː
You can then get a much better idea of the game than a video or a few pictures can show.

The demo includes the first 12 missions and goes up to the first boss.

Although this game has an arcade character, it is full of physics.

You must accelerate if you want to stay in the air (except for the zeppelin, which of course keeps hovering as long as it has fuel). And when you stop accelerating, the plane doesn't stop immediately, but continues to glide a little further until air resistance or gravity has slowed the plane down and force it down.
But no fear. This is not a flight simulator.
You learn it very quickly and it's fun!

If you have any questions or suggestions, let me know on the Community Hub.
